data.content_ref: inline:The proposed relation is 'abstraction,' but the target concedes its own refutation condition mid-artifact: it admits SRC_003's routing-rot rank could 'depend on call-graph frequency rather than blast-radius category.' If the shared schema is genuinely inherited by all six artifacts, priority must be derivable from blast-radius alone; yet the target acknowledges an alternative causal determinant (call-graph frequency) that is independent of blast radius. This is not a harmless caveat — it is an admission that the abstraction leaks: at least one artifact's priority may be governed by a frequency-of-occurrence mechanism rather than by the five-tuple blast-radius schema, meaning the claimed 'single shared ranking schema' does not actually unify the artifacts. The relation is therefore not substantively an inheritance/abstraction; it is a disjunctive classification that fails the moment the conceded alternative materializes.
